reports.notes: Handwritten on the printed v. 12.23 form; the radio buttons are digital (filled dots), the rest is ink. The Office field is hand-printed in capitals as 'SURVEYOR' - no 'County' prefix (index.csv says 'County Surveyor'). The Name of Candidate is hand-printed 'Anthony Canto' with no middle initial (index.csv for the sibling redacted copy says 'Anthony D Canto'). index.csv carries reporting_period='' for this filing; the page resolves it - the marked radio is 'Seven days preceding the General Election'. In Box D the decimal separator is written as a comma-shaped stroke ('1081,12') while Boxes B/C/E/F use a clear period; the digits are unambiguous, so the value is recorded as 1081.12 at medium confidence. Boxes A and Balance at Close are a hand-drawn open loop read as the filer's zero (medium confidence). PRIVACY NOTE: this copy is UNREDACTED - the county published the filer's full street address and phone number in the clear (the sibling filing c7820527 is the same document with those blacked out). Only the residence city is recorded here; the street address and phone are deliberately NOT transcribed into this cache.

contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (1081.12) on the p4 Summary Page — also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (1081.12) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received / Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report' (1081.12)
contributions.detail: The 2 Schedule A rows sum to 500.00 + 581.12 = 1081.12 exactly — equal to the page subtotal, the schedule's grand total, and the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Box B. Box C (Year to Date) prints 1081.12 as well and is NOT summed as an increment. THE ARITHMETIC SETTLED A GLYPH (GOTCHAS / I1): row 1's handwritten amount renders at 900 dpi as an oval-zero form that could be read 500.00, 506.00 or 566.00 — this filer draws 0 as a small open oval. Only 500.00 makes the two rows equal the printed 1081.12 (506.00 would give 1087.12), and the same oval glyph recurs as an unambiguous zero in his 350.00 on Schedule B, which sits on a page that also closes exactly. Reading settled at 500.00 by closure, corroborated by the filer's own comparison glyph.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (1081.12) on the p4 Summary Page — also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (1081.12) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Made' (1081.12)
expenditures.detail: The 3 Schedule B rows sum to 712.25 + 18.87 + 350.00 = 1081.12 exactly — equal to the page subtotal, the schedule's grand total, and Box D. Box E (Year to Date) prints the same and is not summed. 3 of the grid's 15 printed rows are used; row 4 was cropped as the one-past control and rendered an EMPTY boxed cell.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — the v. 12.23 Schedule A here has four columns (Date / Name of Contributor / Address and Zip Code / Amount) with NO in-kind checkbox, and neither schedule carries an in-kind annotation, line or column. Both conventions were tested on both sides and coincide (no in-kind rows exist); monetary-only closes both sides exactly at 1081.12. Determined for THIS filing; nothing was inherited from the filer's other 2024 documents.
itemized.escalation_note: Schedule A row 1 escalated to 900 dpi with --value because the handwritten hundreds digit and cents are ambiguous between 0 and 6 in this hand. The crop rendered '5oo.oo' — visually unresolvable, exactly the I1 hazard — and was settled NOT by the crop but by the page's own arithmetic (500.00 is the only reading that makes the two rows equal the printed 1081.12), with the filer's unambiguous zeros in '350.00' on Schedule B as the comparison glyph. Escalation resolved legibility; the arithmetic resolved truth.

itemized.notes: modern_boxAF, form revision v. 12.23, masthead 'Aaron Davidson, Clerk'. 4 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page' (LAST — located by content). NO CHECKLIST bound. pdfinfo: 4 pages, EVERY PAGE /Rotate 270 (poppler renders them upright portrait). The form is the printed v. 12.23 blank FILLED IN BY HAND in ink, except the report-type and amendment radio buttons, which are digital filled dots — a hybrid the earlier addenda have not recorded: the filer marked the radios in the PDF, printed it, and completed the rest with a pen. Report type marked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment ticked NO; Date of Report hand-written 10/24/24 on all four sheets, each of which also carries its own hand-written page number 1/2/3/4. PAGE-FACE Office box reads simply 'SURVEYOR' in hand-printed capitals, with no 'County' prefix, where index.csv carries 'County Surveyor' from the channel — the page face is recorded here and no office was inferred beyond what it prints. index.csv's reporting_period is BLANK for this row while the page marks its type plainly; the page face governs. THE 2024 CANTO CLUSTER: the county published Anthony Canto's 2024 material under THREE filenames — this one ('2024_Anthony_Canto.pdf', channel state_municipal, published UNREDACTED), plus '2024_Anthony_Canto_Redacted.pdf' (c7820527) and '2024_Anthony_Canto_Redacted_1_.pdf' (aa48bfdb). Each is transcribed INDEPENDENTLY and on its own terms; nothing here was merged, netted or differenced against another copy, and the kind-classification of the three is set out in each record's notes. PRIVACY: this copy is UNREDACTED and prints the candidate's own street address and telephone number in the clear on the cover. NEITHER IS CARRIED — not into a field, not into a note — exactly as they would not be from a redacted copy; only the residence city/state appear on the page and they are not needed by any row here. The donor side carries no street line at all (the filer wrote city and state only), so the privacy reduction is a no-op on Schedule A.
